messages:
Lina: Heads-up: VertexAI (enterprise) wants a 12-month Dedicated commit but with flexible autoscale and a 2.5x burst window for monthly peaks. Asking for 18% off list for the full commit plus 3 months of free engineering support during onboarding. Can we get Deal Desk + Finance eyes on this?
Jonah: Need the target commit size. Also which GPU types/regions? That affects list rate.
Lina: They want an initial pool of 5 GPUs sustained (equiv ~3600 GPU-hours/mo), mixed nv A100s in us-west and some H100 in eu-west for batch peaks. They want autoscale up to 15 GPUs for short bursts (2.5x) and a hard cap on burst cost.
Marta: Deal Desk: 18% off for a 12mo commit is near our upper bound. We usually approve up to 15% for standard 12mo. Exceptions allowed with refundable credit language or guaranteed minimum ARR. Is customer willing to sign an upsell clause?
Tom: Finance: 18% can be entertained if customer commits to a minimum monthly spend and we include a revenue protection clause. Also need to confirm how burst metering is billed (separate PO or on the same invoice).
Lina: Customer open to a min monthly spend equal to 85% of the committed hours for the term. They want burst billed at discounted rate (not full pay-as-you-go) — proposing 1.75x list for burst hours.
Jonah: Quick back-of-envelope: list = A100 $1.8/hr, H100 $3.2/hr. If they keep 70% A100 / 30% H100 and sustain 3600 hrs: list monthly = (2520*1.8? wait) hold on I'll compute: 2520? ignore, compute explicitly.
Jonah: Calculation: 3600*0.7=2520 A100 hrs -> 2520*1.8 = 4536; 3600*0.3=1080 H100 hrs -> 1080*3.2 = 3456. Total list = 7992 USD/mo. With 18% off -> 6553 USD/mo. Burst up to 15 GPUs intermittent billed at 1.75x list for additional hours.
Marta: Deal Desk proposal: approve up to 17% discount conditional on: (1) signed 12mo MSA, (2) minimum monthly invoice floor (85% of committed hours), (3) burst multiplier capped at 1.75x and burst hrs capped at 25% of monthly commit, (4) onboarding credits limited to 3 months and documented. Anything >17% needs CRO sign-off.
Tom: Finance concurs with 17% conditional. If they insist on 18% we need CRO + CFO signoff and a prepayment or early termination fees.
legal-bot: For SOW we need explicit invoicing terms for burst usage, credit application mechanics, and a clause for capacity fallback (H100 unavailable -> A100 replacement at same effective cost). Also require data handling and SSO clauses for enterprise.
Lina: Customer prefers the A100 fallback clause. They also asked for a 3-month ramp where we waive overage charges for initial spikes (to be converted into onboarding credits if they hit steady state).
Marta: We can offer onboarding credits equal to 20% of first-month invoice, applied only if they convert to full commit within 30 days after ramp. Otherwise credits are forfeited. Add that to the exception memo.
Jonah: Ops config (for infra team): ```pool: "vertex-dedicated-1" gpus: [{type:"A100",pct:70},{type:"H100",pct:30}] commit_hours: 3600/month autoscale: {max_gpus:15, burst_multiplier:2.5, burst_cap_pct:25} billing: {burst_multiplier:1.75, min_invoice_pct:85}```
infra-bot: Provisioning ticket created: ticket=INC-2026-987, tentative pool vertex-dedicated-1, pending legal + billing sign-off.
Lina: Thanks everyone. I'll push SOW draft with the 17% conditional terms and attach the customer's signature timeline. If they counter to 18% we'll escalate to CRO.
Marta: Deal Desk approved (conditional) :white_check_mark: 
Marta: I'll attach the internal approval note to the ticket.
Tom: Finance provisional approval :money_with_wings: 
Tom: Final ratification after signed MSA and invoice floor confirmed.
Lina: Closing loop here for now 
Lina: Will update thread when SOW is signed or if customer escalates.
